data.title: 姬柊雪菜 · 雨后车站的倾斜伞面
data.description: 放学后雨水沥沥的电车站台外，雪菜与你共撑一把透明雨伞。她悄悄把伞面完全倾斜到你身上，任由自己半边制服肩膀被细雨微润，红着脸颊低下头不敢对视。
data.location: rainy train station entrance beside puddle reflections
data.action: sharing transparent umbrella, tilting umbrella toward partner, wet shoulder, blushing shyly, looking down with sweet smile
data.lighting: diffuse cool rainlight with sparkling street puddle reflections
data.mood: sweet adolescent romance, selfless devotion, gentle rainy nostalgia
data.promptProse: Sharing an umbrella on a rainy street corner, Yukina tilts the umbrella toward her senior, blushing sweetly with rain-dampened shoulders.
data.animaCaption: Tilting the umbrella toward the viewer in the rain, she smiles sweetly with a tender blush.
